profile.Name: Luquin
profile.Personality: Knows everyone in Shark and has an arrangement with most of them. Reads people well, judges no one, and forgets nothing.
profile.Backstory: He has lived in Shark long enough to know who has what and who needs it, and makes introductions without anyone getting killed.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Easy and friendly, with every word chosen to keep doors open.
